tagline: Climb the searches your customers make, one rung at a time
intro: We are a search agency for growing online shops and service brands. We work through what lifts a site in search and in AI answers, in order, and tell you every month which rung you are on.
audience: UK online shops and service brands with a site that works but is rarely found, usually with a small in-house team and no one dedicated to search yet.
pricing_note: A monthly retainer in three sizes, set by how much content and development you need. Six months to start, because climbing takes time, then rolling monthly.

services.title: Foundations
services.description: Speed, crawling, indexing and site structure fixed first, because nothing else lifts you while search engines and AI crawlers cannot read the site properly.

services.title: Product and service pages
services.description: Every page that sells rewritten to answer what buyers search for and ask AI assistants, with clear titles, specifics and prices.

services.title: Guides and answers
services.description: Buying guides, comparisons and plain answers to common questions, the pages people and AI answers turn to before they choose.

services.title: Links and mentions
services.description: Honest outreach to the publications, directories and partners your customers already read, so other sites point to yours.

process.title: Find your rung
process.description: An audit of your site, your searches and what AI assistants say about you, so we know where you stand and what to fix first.

process.title: Work up in order
process.description: Foundations first, then pages, then guides, then links. Each month has a short plan you approve before we start.

process.title: Check every month
process.description: A plain report on the searches that matter to you, what moved, what did not and which rung comes next.

proof.text: For the first time someone explained what to fix first and why, and then did it.
Our product pages finally say what customers want to know before they buy.
Clear monthly plans, no jargon, and they always do what they said they would.
